settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyNote: On-chain privacy settings are controlled by runtime; this screen only shows current client flags.
settings.privacyDeleteRecallNote: Local delete hides messages on your devices only (via archive tombstones); it does not remove copies on the peer's device or in the relay mailbox. Recall shows a placeholder on both sides within 2 minutes but does not revoke IPFS media the peer already fetched.
settings.notifNote: Browser notifications and sounds will be added in a future release.
settings.dataChainAnchorNote: When on (Standard tier), an encrypted sync anchor is published on-chain so a new device can restore chats, contacts and archive with only the mnemonic. Visible on-chain: that an anchor exists, its update cadence, ciphertext length and the fee-paying account; backup blob CIDs also appear in the operator's storage/Crust pin orders. Conversation content, contacts and the CIDs inside the anchor stay encrypted. Turn off for relay-only sync with zero on-chain metadata.
settings.dataNote: Open IPFS Pin Manager from the settings sidebar.
settings.aboutFeature2: On-chain chat_* control plane + relay delivery
